cr.p1: Showing each piece in a real space meant editing every photograph by hand, which delayed publishing the catalogue.
cr.p2: We built a private admin panel with AI assistance. Whoever manages the catalogue uploads the photo, enters the measurements and picks a room. The system straightens the image, places it to scale and leaves it ready to publish.
cr.t: From a phone photo to an artwork shown in a room, at real scale.
cr.n1: Recording of the panel in use.
cr.c1: Original photo, taken on a phone.
cr.c2: Result: the same piece, corrected and at real scale (120 × 90 cm). Reference image.
cr.e1: Faithful to the artwork. The AI only adjusts the light and shadow of the setting. The published piece is always the original photograph.
cr.e2: Automatic check. If the AI alters the piece, the system detects it and discards the result.
cr.e3: Real scale. Seven calibrated rooms, so the dimensions of each piece match the real ones.
cr.e4: No learning curve. A guided flow used from a phone, with no training needed.
cr.w: The public catalogue: bilingual, with a page per piece and direct enquiries over WhatsApp.
gc.p1: Both sell through Instagram and WhatsApp, with catalogues that lived in Canva presentations. They needed a shop where customers build their order, and a way to update it without asking anyone.
gc.p2: We built a shop whose cart sends the complete order over WhatsApp, plus an admin panel for the owner. The second shop started from the first: the same tested base, with a design taken from each brand's catalogue and logo.
gc.quien: Gioia and Calu, accessories and swimwear shops
gc.t: Two shops on the same base, each with its own brand identity.
gc.n1: Gioia: a price is changed in the panel and the shop shows it straight away.
gc.n2: Calu: each garment breaks out of its frame, as in her printed catalogue.
gc.e1: Admin from a phone. Products, photos, prices, sold-out items and orders, without touching code.
gc.e2: Catalogue migrated. Over 200 pieces moved from her Canva catalogue into the shop, each with its cropped photo.
gc.e3: Reliable orders. The server recalculates prices and totals before logging the order.
gc.e4: Fitted to each one. Calu filters by size and adds delivery by area; Gioia applies its wholesale price.
at.p1: A psychologist who works in Spanish and English wanted to present herself calmly and be easy to contact. And not depend on anyone to change a fee or a sentence.
at.p2: We built the site and a custom editor with a live preview. She taps any text, changes it and decides when to publish.
at.t: A site its owner edits herself: copy, photo, fees and even the typography.
at.n1: Recording of the editor: every change shows in the preview before publishing.
at.e1: An online-shop style editor. Copy, photo, fees and contact details, in Spanish and English.
at.e2: Design with guardrails. Four fixed type pairings and a warning if a colour makes text hard to read.
at.e3: Nothing gets lost. Each publish keeps the previous version; any of the last 30 can be restored.
at.e4: Its own concept. "A tempo" means returning to the original tempo: a line breathing at six breaths a minute runs through the page.
ob.p1: A company with twenty years of projects had its track record in a PDF brochure, with small photos that were hard to share.
ob.p2: We built a site that carries over the brochure's identity and gives each project its own page: scope, works carried out, technical data and photo record.
ob.t: Every project with its own technical report, the way it is presented to an industrial client.
ob.n1: A project's technical report, on a phone.
ob.e1: A page per project. A technical report with contents, technical data and photo viewer, ready to send to a client.
ob.e2: The brochure's identity. The roof shape, the yellow and the giant 0701 come from their printed material.
ob.e3: Photos recovered. The brochure images came in small; each one was enlarged and corrected.
ob.e4: Vector logo. Traced from the original so it stays sharp at any size.
av.quien: Avanza con Gabriel, CV and interview sessions
av.t: A site that practises what it teaches: it reads like a good CV.
av.p1: Gabriel helps people prepare their CV and interviews. The site shows his method with a real example and lets people book a session without leaving the page.
av.e1: Before and after. A sample CV that switches with a tap, with key phrases underlined.
av.e2: Booking on the page. The calendar opens right there, loading nothing until it is asked for.
av.e3: Hand-cut photos. Gabriel stands in front of the CV sheet.
om.t: A portfolio that presents her work to a brand in under a minute.
om.p1: Omary produces video for beauty brands. Her portfolio used to be a slide deck; it is now a site of her own, with the work by category and a direct channel to request a quote.
om.e1: Custom design. Developed from her visual identity, with no template.
om.e2: Processed video. Each piece is treated to keep its original colour.
om.e3: Bilingual. Spanish or English, depending on the visitor's language.
fi.quien: La Tiendita del Fisio, physiotherapy equipment
fi.t: Selling in two currencies, with the exchange rate updated every hour.
fi.p1: Over 140 products priced in dollars and paid in local currency. The shop works out every price at the official rate of the day and turns the cart into a WhatsApp order.
fi.e1: Automatic exchange rate. The official rate is checked every hour, with no manual work.
fi.e2: Structured order. It arrives on WhatsApp with products, quantities and total, and is logged.
fi.e3: Self-managed. The owner updates products, prices and photos from her panel.
s1.d: With WhatsApp ordering or online payment, depending on how the business sells.
s2.d: To update products, prices and orders from a phone, without depending on a developer.
s3.d: To change the copy, photos and fees of a services site, with a preview before publishing.
s4.d: They automate repetitive work, such as preparing product photos, with checks that verify the result.
s5.d: Track record, services and a page per project, using the identity the company already has.
s6.d: To show the work and let clients book or ask for a quote without leaving the page.
s7.d: Prices converted at the day's exchange rate and content in each visitor's language.
titulo: We build custom websites, and the tools for each business to run them on its own.
quienes: Shops with WhatsApp ordering, services sites, portfolios and company websites. Every project starts from how the business works today and ends in something its team runs without depending on us.
entrada: Recent projects, and the problem each one solved.
tuyo.p: We work on specific sales and operations problems. Every service is in at least one project on this page.
contacto.t: Tell us what your business needs.
contacto.p: Describe what you sell and the problem you want to solve. We reply with a specific proposal, in Spanish or English.
